title: Topical Application of Insecticidal Active Ingredients
author: Edmund J. Norris
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q7idzke

steps.title: Anesthetize female mosquitoes
steps.instruction: Anesthetize all female mosquitoes using carbon dioxide gas.

substeps.instruction: Slowly increase the flow of CO2 from a gas cylinder equipped with a regulator and hose to a gentle stream.
Flow CO2 into the container for 30 seconds, covering the container with a hand to ensure the concentration builds.

steps.title: Prepare chilled petri dishes
steps.instruction: Prepare two 90-mm glass petri dish bottoms on ice to maintain mosquito anesthesia.

substeps.instruction: Place two 90-mm glass petri dish bottoms on ice.
Place two 90-mm filter papers on the bottom surface of the petri dishes to prevent excess condensation.

steps.title: Transfer mosquitoes to ice
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer anesthetized mosquitoes into the chilled petri dishes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer fewer than 200 mosquitoes to the petri dish at a time to prevent them from remaining on ice too long and failing to reanimate.

steps.title: Apply insecticidal solution
steps.instruction: Apply the insecticidal solution to individual mosquitoes using a repeating dispenser.

substeps.instruction: Verify the repeating dispenser is functioning by pumping and tapping the tip to a kimwipe to detect a solvent droplet.
Pick up each mosquito by the hind legs with featherweight forceps (Bioquip).
Apply 0.2 μL (one pump of the repeating dispenser) of insecticidal solution to the pronotum of each mosquito.
Treat a total of 25 mosquitoes per treatment group (insecticide concentration).
Move treated mosquitoes to the second petri dish on ice to prevent premature reanimation or sticking to the observation cup.

steps.title: Transfer to observation container
steps.instruction: Transfer the 25 treated mosquitoes from the secondary petri dish into an observation container.

substeps.instruction: Use a small 8-ounce deli cup with tulle placed over the top for ventilation.

steps.title: Incubate mosquitoes
steps.instruction: Place the observation container in an incubator to maintain specific environmental conditions.

substeps.instruction: Set incubator to 28°C with approximately 80% relative humidity.
Provide a cotton pad moistened with 10% sucrose water to prevent desiccation.

steps.title: Record knockdown and mortality
steps.instruction: Evaluate the efficacy of the insecticide by recording knockdown and mortality rates.

substeps.instruction: Record percentage knockdown at 1 hour (defined as inability to fly or orient in the upright direction).
Record percentage mortality at 24 hours (defined as ataxia/inability to move after prodding with a camelhair brush).
Note: Toxicity endpoints may be adjusted if necessary (e.g., 2-hr knockdown, 48-hr mortality).
Ensure a minimum of 3 biological cohorts from different rearing groups are included in the data set.
